meta_description: CRL Locksmith Manchester. Emergency lockout, lock repair, and key cutting. 24/7 response. Fully insured. Call for rapid assistance today.
hero_eyebrow: 24/7 Emergency Response — Locked Out? We're On Our Way
hero_subhead: Locked out of your home or business in Manchester? We arrive within the hour, any time of day or night.
services_subhead: From emergency lockouts to lock repairs and key cutting, we handle every locksmith need with speed and expertise.

services.title: Emergency Lockouts
services.desc: Locked out of your home, office, or car? We arrive fast and gain entry without damage, keeping disruption to a minimum. Available 24/7, including weekends and bank holidays.

services.title: Lock Repair & Replacement
services.desc: Broken locks, worn mechanisms, or damaged doors? We repair or replace locks swiftly, restoring security and function to your property.

services.title: Key Cutting
services.desc: Duplicate keys cut while you wait for homes, businesses, offices, and vehicles. We use precision equipment to ensure perfect fit every time.

services.title: Lock Installation
services.desc: New security locks fitted to doors, gates, and outbuildings. We advise on the best type for your needs and install to professional standards.

services.title: Cylinder & Mechanism Replacement
services.desc: Worn or damaged lock cylinders replaced quickly and efficiently. Ideal after break-ins or when keys go missing for added peace of mind.

services.title: Commercial Lock Security
services.desc: Business premises need robust security. We fit commercial-grade locks, master systems, and security hardware tailored to your requirements.

about_pullquote: A lockout is stressful enough — we make sure the fix isn't.
about_para_1: CRL Locksmith has served Manchester and the surrounding areas for over 15 years. We started because we knew how frustrating and frightening a lockout could be — and how hard it was to find someone reliable at 2am. Today, we're the go-to local locksmith for homeowners and businesses across the city, handling everything from emergency lockouts to full security upgrades.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on speed, honesty, and fair pricing. We carry stock on our vans, diagnose problems quickly, and work without unnecessary delay. Most customers call us back because they trust us to turn up when we say we will, sort the problem properly, and not overcharge for the privilege.
reviews_heading: What Manchester Customers Say About Us

reviews.text: Locked myself out on a Sunday afternoon and was panicking. Called CRL and someone picked up straight away. The lad arrived within an hour, got me back in without any fuss or damage, and only charged me what was quoted over the phone. Brilliant service. Will definitely use them again.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Had a break-in and needed new locks fitted urgently. CRL came the next morning, fitted quality locks to the front and back doors, and explained everything clearly. Felt safe again straightaway. Fair price and no messing about. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Claire M.

reviews.text: Lost my keys and needed spares cut and the house lock changed. CRL did both on the same visit and it didn't cost the earth. Professional bloke, knows what he's doing. Top marks.
reviews.author: Steven H.

opening_hours_sub: We're always available — day, night, weekends, bank holidays
